title: laboratory.result.v1
description: A measured laboratory assay/analysis result ingested directly from an instrument (e.g. an Agilent 2000-series AA spectrometer via SpectrAA). The measured value is stored write-once; the original raw record is preserved and hashed so tampering is detectable. Corrections never mutate this record — they are separate laboratory.correction.v1 entries.

result_id.description: Deterministic id so replay/backfill of the same result is idempotent.

instrument.description: The instrument that produced the result, e.g. agilent-aa-2000.

sample_ref.description: Opaque sample identifier — how the lab labels the sample. Never personal data.

element.description: The analyte, e.g. Au, Ag, Cu.

unit.description: Unit of value, e.g. g/t, ppm, %.

original_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the canonicalised original record — tamper-evidence for the immutable original.

original_file_ref.description: Object-store URI of the original export file (MinIO), when offloaded. Null until then.

source.description: Ingest source, e.g. spectraa_csv, manual, import.

provenance.description: This record carries a measured instrument value, never an estimate or inference.
